metadata.description: Admin-only financial visibility for payments, balances, wallet ledger, usage spend, and reconciliation warnings.
objectives: Give admins a single trustworthy view of customer payments and remaining paid/bonus balances.
Keep payment, ledger, usage, and currency semantics explicit and non-overlapping.
Provide safe, accessible, filterable, exportable financial operations without exposing provider secrets.
Reuse existing billing tables and dependencies; add only fork-owned reporting surfaces.
assumptions: RUB remains the default operational currency, but API aggregates never mix currencies.
Provider paid_at/refund/chargeback facts are not yet durable; processed_at is labeled as a fallback.
Existing admin authorization is the only role required for the first increment.
No new runtime dependency or reporting warehouse is introduced.
